description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” visually compares the inference runtime (in seconds) of “Our Joint Framework” against four large language models (LLMs): ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400 with major gridlines at 50-second intervals. The horizontal axis lists the five models being compared. A legend in the upper left indicates that “Our Joint Framework” is represented by a dark green bar, while “LLM Models” are shown in light blue. The chart shows that “Our Joint Framework” achieves a runtime of 77 seconds — significantly lower than all LLMs tested. ChatGPT requires 190 seconds, DeepSeek the longest at 365 seconds, LLaMA takes 172 seconds, and Claude requires 243 seconds. Notably, only one bar — “Our Joint Framework” — is colored green; all other bars are blue, suggesting the comparison is between a single proposed system and multiple baseline LLMs. The chart emphasizes the efficiency of the proposed framework in a streaming context, with runtime values explicitly labeled atop each bar for clarity.
